invariants.rationale: The savepoint method returns a HoodieSavepointMetadata, which is likely expected to be non-null as it represents the created savepoint's metadata.
A valid instantToSavepoint should be a non-null, non-empty string as it designates the commit time to be savepointed.
The user creating the savepoint should be specified as a non-null, non-empty string.
A comment should be provided (can be empty but not null) as part of the savepoint metadata.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to perform any metadata operations for savepoint creation.
